core_obligations: Recognise the situation (proof lines 7479-7499): the author observes that the morphism Y -> X is obtained by base change along the limit Spec(B) = lim Spec(B_i), so that the general commutation theorem for such limits applies with the sheaf pulled back from X.
Read off the identification (proof lines 7499-7507): applying that theorem gives the displayed equality of the cohomology of Y with the colimit of the cohomologies of the Y_i.
proof_roadmap: Identify Y as the limit of the Y_i with affine transition morphisms.
Apply the general theorem on cohomology of a limit of schemes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the etale cohomology of the base change of a quasi-compact quasi-separated X along a directed colimit of A-algebras with the colimit of the cohomologies of the intermediate base changes (statement lines 7463-7477). The proof is short: the author recognises the situation as a limit of schemes with affine transition morphisms and applies the general commutation theorem for cohomology of such limits (proof lines 7479-7507). The content is the recognition that the sheaf in question is pulled back from X, which makes the general theorem applicable. The claim is H2: one reduction to a known theorem.
